verdict.rationale: Featurebase has a dedicated changelog feature with a Notion-like editor, standalone branded page with custom domain, embeddable widgets, email subscriptions, and audience segmentation for targeted release notes—directly enabling a PM to publish and distribute a changelog. It also auto-notifies users whose requests were shipped, closing the loop with customers who requested the feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy.
